outcome: The single package compiles with reproducible tools and typed errors that preserve their CLI category.

artifacts.purpose: Exact tested stable compiler, rustfmt, clippy
Typed diagnostic codes and exit categories

interfaces: Error stores stable code/stage/path/affected IDs and safe message; no payload interpolation.
Shared constants include wire 2, specification version, categorical sum tolerance 1e-9, fixture tolerance, ten-bin convention.
No new CLI command or empty module is introduced until its behavior exists.
acceptance_criteria: Exact stable toolchain and actual host are recorded; MSRV is the minimum compiler actually tested.
All specified error codes retain exit 2/3/4 classification and serialize finite valid JSON.
No production panic/unwrap/expect, bypass attributes, asynchronous runtime, or extra package.

verification.expected: All stable codes map to the specified exit category without parsing messages.
Opaque input and credential sentinel values do not appear in errors.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
